title: Bank of America spends $250 million a year on GLP-1 drugs for its employees, CEO says
excerpt: Employers have grappled with soaring demand for GLP-1 drugs such as Ozempic and Wegovy, which can cost thousands of dollars per patient annually.
content_html:
watch now

Bank of America spends more than $250 million a year covering GLP-1 weight loss drugs for its employees, CEO Brian Moynihan told CNBC on Wednesday, saying the rapidly rising cost is a worthwhile investment in his workforce.

The company sets aside more than $2 billion a year on healthcare overall for BofA's roughly 211,000 employees, meaning that GLP-1 medications alone now account for roughly 13% of all healthcare spending, per figures provided by Moynihan.

"We spend about $250 million or more on GLPs, and that's up from zero" four or five years ago, Moynihan told CNBC's Andrew Ross Sorkin. "We see a great impact on the employees."

Employers across the country have grappled with soaring demand for GLP-1 drugs such as Ozempic and Wegovy, which can cost thousands of dollars per patient annually. Many self-insured companies and public employers have dropped or restricted coverage or debated whether they can afford the treatments as utilization has climbed.

Moynihan acknowledged that some employees may leave Bank of America before the company realizes the long-term savings from improved health, but he said the decision ultimately reflects a push to provide valuable benefits.

Bank of America pairs access to the drugs with health coaching to help monitor weight loss and lifestyle adjustments, the CEO said. Beyond long-term preventative health, Moynihan pointed to emerging clinical data suggesting nearer-term benefits, including a lower incidence of cardiovascular events.

"It's been fascinating to watch our teammates' behavior on these adjustments — the loss of weight," he said.

Costly coverage

The nation's second-largest lender by assets is also using its size to negotiate lower prices from drugmakers and pharmacy benefit managers, he said.

"Believe me, we're pounding everybody on price and trying to get as cheap [as possible]," Moynihan said. "But our view is that [because of] the long-term health benefits, plus there may be more short-term health benefits ... it's a good investment."

Around 36% of employers said they provide coverage of GLP-1s for both diabetes and weight loss, according to a survey released in July by the International Foundation of Employee Benefit Plans, or IFEBP, which includes more than 30,000 member companies or public institutions.

Though that percentage is up slightly from 34% in 2024, it's flat from 2025, the survey found. 

Cost remains a primary driver in employer decisions around GLP-1 coverage: In 2026, respondents to the IFEBP survey said the drugs accounted for 11.4% of annual claims, up from 6.9% in 2023.

Obesity drugmakers Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk have been pushing to boost employer coverage, which is key to unlocking greater uptake for their treatments. The discounted cash prices of those drugs, which are several hundred dollars a month depending on the dose, are still unsustainable for some patients.

In March, Lilly launched a new program designed to give employers more flexibility in how they cover treatments. Through the effort, employers can pay a net discounted price of $449 per month for a new multi-dose form of Zepbound across all doses.

现在观看

美国银行首席执行官布赖恩·莫伊尼汉 (Brian Moynihan) 周三向 CNBC 表示，美国银行每年为其员工购买 GLP-1 减肥药的费用超过 2.5 亿美元，他表示，快速上涨的成本对于其员工来说是一项值得的投资。

该公司每年为美国银行约 211,000 名员工拨出超过 20 亿美元用于医疗保健，这意味着根据 Moynihan 提供的数据，仅 GLP-1 药物目前就约占所有医疗保健支出的 13%。

莫伊尼汉对 CNBC 的安德鲁·罗斯·索金 (Andrew Ross Sorkin) 表示，“我们在 GLP 上花费了约 2.5 亿美元或更多，这比四五年前的零还要多”。 “我们看到这对员工产生了巨大的影响。”

全国各地的雇主都在努力应对 Ozempic 和 Wegovy 等 GLP-1 药物不断飙升的需求，这些药物每年每位患者的费用可能高达数千美元。 随着利用率的上升，许多自保公司和公共雇主已经放弃或限制了承保范围，或者争论他们是否能够负担得起治疗费用。

莫伊尼汉承认，一些员工可能会在公司意识到改善健康带来的长期节省之前离开美国银行，但他表示，这一决定最终反映了提供有价值福利的努力。

这位首席执行官表示，美国银行将药物的获取与健康指导结合起来，以帮助监测体重减轻和生活方式的调整。 除了长期的预防性健康之外，莫伊尼汉还指出，新出现的临床数据表明了近期的好处，包括降低心血管事件的发生率。

“观察我们的队友在这些调整（体重减轻）方面的行为真是令人着迷，”他说。

保险费用昂贵

他表示，按资产计算，美国第二大贷款机构也在利用其规模与制药商和药品福利管理者谈判降低价格。

“相信我，我们正在对每个人进行价格打击，并试图获得尽可能便宜的价格，”莫伊尼汉说。 “但我们的观点是，[因为]长期的健康益处，加上可能还有更多的短期健康益处...... 这是一项很好的投资。”

国际员工福利计划基金会 (IFEBP) 7 月份发布的一项调查显示，大约 36% 的雇主表示他们为糖尿病和减肥提供 GLP-1 保险，该基金会包括 30,000 多家会员公司或公共机构。

调查发现，尽管这一比例比 2024 年的 34% 略有上升，但与 2025 年持平。

成本仍然是雇主决定 GLP-1 承保范围的主要驱动因素：2026 年，IFEBP 调查的受访者表示，这些药物占年度索赔的 11.4%，高于 2023 年的 6.9%。

肥胖制药商礼来（Eli Lilly）和诺和诺德（Novo Nordisk）一直在努力提高雇主的保险覆盖率，这是提高其治疗方法被更多人接受的关键。 这些药物的折扣现金价格根据剂量每月为数百美元，但对一些患者来说仍然难以承受。

今年三月，礼来公司推出了一项新计划，旨在让雇主在支付治疗费用方面拥有更大的灵活性。 通过这一努力，雇主可以每月以 449 美元的净折扣价购买所有剂量的新型多剂量 Zepbound。
